# Melting
Fixture Thermal Science

<!-- slide -->
## Learning objectives
1. State the melting point of pure water at standard pressure.
2. Explain why the temperature stays constant while a pure solid melts.

<!-- slide template=outline -->
## What we will cover
- The melting point of a pure solid
- The latent heat of fusion

<!-- slide template=section -->
## The melting point

<!-- slide -->
## Melting point of pure water
At standard pressure the melting point of pure water is 0 °C.

<!-- slide -->
## Latent heat of fusion
Melting pure water absorbs 334 J/g while the temperature stays constant.

<!-- slide template=closing -->
## Summary
A pure solid melts at a characteristic temperature; the energy goes into the phase change.
